annotations.title: Website Audit (Tech, SSL, Accessibility, GDPR, Domain)

description: One call audits a site: tech stack, TLS certificate, accessibility (WCAG, grade), GDPR cookies and trackers before consent, domain and email security, optional screenshot. Returns a sorted issue list, grades and each section; a failed section is reported in checks while the others still return. Cheaper than calling the six checks separately. Set screenshot false to skip the image. Price: $0.055 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"url":"https://example.com","screenshot":false}.
